Interface

Detection

Detection layers

Five independent layers. Keep all of them on for maximum coverage; turn them off only if a site misbehaves.

LayerWhat it hooksNeedsOn
1. Networkfetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, EventSource + webRequest<all_urls>
2. DOMMutationObserver + poll over video/source/iframe/embed-
3. MSEMediaSource, SourceBuffer, blob interception, EMEMAIN
4. Service workercaches scan, SW registration probe-
5. Heuristicsinline scripts, performance entries, player internals-

Subtitles & API keys

Wyzie, SubDL and OpenSubtitles need a free key; YIFY works without one. Keys are stored only in your browser and sent only to their own provider.

Help

        

          
First-time setup

          
    
            
  1. Load dist/chrome or dist/firefox as unpacked / temporary add-on.
    2. 
            
  2. Paste a free Wyzie or SubDL key in Subtitles & API keys for automatic Indonesian subtitles.
    3. 
            
  3. Open a video, press play, then use the floating button or Alt+Shift+S.
    4. 
            
  4. Click Watch Party on a stream to open watchparty.me with your title as the room name.
    5. 
          

          
Shortcuts

          
Alt+Shift+S panel, Alt+Shift+D re-scan, Alt+Shift+F subtitles, Esc close panel

          
Privacy

          
Stream Radar runs entirely on your machine.
